name: Image Optimizer
blurb: Image Optimizer makes PNG and JPEG files smaller without changing how they look.
description:
Image Optimizer makes PNG and JPEG files smaller without changing how they look. It rewrites the files you pick in place, so the file you selected is the one that gets smaller.

The compression is lossless, which means the pixels come out identical and nothing is re-encoded at a lower quality. What comes off is whatever the encoder left on the table, so screenshots and interface images usually gain the most and photos straight out of a camera the least.

Features:

• Compress PNG and JPEG images without losing quality

• Optimize a whole batch at once, several files at a time

• Works offline, with no account and nothing uploaded

• Keeps the colour profile and the orientation, so images still look the way they did

• Keeps modification times, so a library sorted by date stays in order

• Quit quickly by pressing Ctrl + Q

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
